tower.description: International-standard digital identity verification gateway for global supply chains, certified under EPCIS 2.0 and attribute-based access control (ABAC L4).
tower.feature1Desc: Capture and reconcile Object, Aggregation, and Transaction event chains per ISO/IEC 19987.
tower.feature2Desc: Monitor ultra-threshold temperature excursions and automatically quarantine at-risk SSCC/GTIN lots.
tower.feature3Desc: Synchronize over 1,400,000 enterprise entities, warehouses, and global handover points.
